title: Automated capability-gap detector — Capability specification
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Automated capability-gap detector is a super-advanced writing and creation capability. Purpose: identifies missing knowledge, tools, or implementations.. Inputs: a defined objective with constraints and acceptance criteria. Outputs: the specified artifact — code, design, analysis, or verified result — plus its evidence package. Constraints: available compute, data, tools, and permissions. Expected behavior: the capability either produces a verified result or reports exactly what is missing. Capability-development catalog: this entry describes a capability to be developed, not a claim that it already exists in one finished system. Implementation must be demonstrated through testing — every record carries an executed fragment plus its verification test.
capabilities: Specify the automated capability-gap detector capability precisely
Identify required knowledge, algorithms, and tools
Execute the capability fragment and verify it
Enforce operational limits and permissions
Record evidence of readiness honestly

demo.title: Executable fragment runs: Ranked retrieval fragment
demo.code:
function rankSearch(docs,q){var qs=q.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);if(!qs.length)return [];return docs.map(function(d){var t=d.toLowerCase();var s=qs.reduce(function(a,w){return a+(t.split(w).length-1);},0);return {doc:d,score:s};}).filter(function(x){return x.score>0;}).sort(function(a,b){return b.score-a.score;});}
var r=rankSearch(['apple pie','apple tart','banana'],'apple');J(r);assert(r.length===2&&r[0].score>=r[1].score,'rank');
